title: Anki Leech Queue Age
dataSources: Reviews (`language:review`), lessons (`language:lesson`), immersion sessions (`language:immersion`), tutor sessions (`language:tutor`), sync states (`language:sync`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Anki review logs, Duolingo lessons, Babbel course exports, immersion-hour trackers, and tutor-session notes — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=language:review deck=* leech_state=*
| stats sum(eval(if(leech_state="open",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by deck
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending leech cards backlog by deck for deck maintenance.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside deck maintenance.
implementation: Mark each `language:review` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `deck`.
visualization: Table of deck with pending leech cards counts.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds where unfinished leech cards are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in deck maintenance.
